bounded_statement: In this workflow the emission-weighted comparison was computed against the complement (1 - panel_leak_call) of the supplied reference-panel values rather than against the panel values in their supplied coding, while the report claims the comparison was made in the supplied coding. Consequently the reported per-unit agreement rate (0.2000) and confirmed emission inventory (934 kg/day) are the complement-coding results; the supplied-coding results would be 20/25 = 0.8000 and 9142 kg/day. The report is also internally inconsistent: it states 20 of 25 units agree yet reports an agreement rate of 0.2000.

counterevidence_considered.description: Against my verdict: the report's line 'Units whose observed call equals the reference-panel call: 20' matches the correct supplied-coding agreement count, suggesting some supplied-coding computation was performed. However, tracing the code shows this figure is staged_agreement_units = total_units - concordant_units, a derived display value; the rate (0.2000) and emission (934) actually used by the accumulation come from the complemented comparison, and 20/25 is arithmetically inconsistent with the reported rate 0.2000, so this line does not rescue the report.

evidence.description: The workflow complements every supplied panel value before any comparison; PANEL_BASELINE is 1, so this is 1 - panel_call for each unit.
evidence.observed_value: panel_reference_values holds the bitwise complement of panel_calls

source_refs.quoted_text: panel_reference_values = [PANEL_BASELINE - value for value in panel_calls]

evidence.description: The agreement selectors that drive both the reported agreement rate and the emission accumulation are computed against the complemented values, not the supplied panel_calls.
evidence.observed_value: selectors compare observed_calls to panel_reference_values (the complement)

source_refs.quoted_text: selectors = [agreement_selector(observed_calls[index], panel_reference_values[index]) for index in range(total_units)]

agreement_rate = concordant_units / total_units
emission_terms = [daily_rates[index] * selectors[index] for index in range(total_units)]

evidence.description: The reported emission-accumulation agreement rate 0.2000 equals 5/25, the count of units where observed_leak_call equals 1 - panel_leak_call (WP-04, WP-07, WP-13, WP-19, WP-24); the supplied-coding rate is 20/25 = 0.8000.

evidence.description: The accumulated emission 934 kg/day equals the sum of measured_kg_per_day over exactly the five complement-coding-concordant pads (95+176+358+118+187 = 934), not the twenty supplied-coding-concordant pads (which sum to 9142).

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to falsify the verdict three ways. (1) I checked whether PANEL_BASELINE - value could be an identity or legitimate re-coding: PANEL_BASELINE is 1 and panel values are 0/1, so it is strictly the complement, and no protocol amendment authorizes a re-coding (the report itself denies any deviation). (2) I independently recomputed both codings from inputs/data.csv: supplied coding gives 20/25 agreement (rate 0.8000) and a selected emission of 9142 kg/day; complement coding gives 5/25 (rate 0.2000) and 934 kg/day. The reported rate and emission match the complement coding exactly, ruling out coincidence. (3) I checked whether the reported '20 of 25 in agreement' could indicate the emission used supplied coding: it cannot, because the emission terms are built from the same complement-based selectors, and 934 is reproducible only from the five complement-concordant pads. All three attempts failed to overturn the verdict.

root_cause: workflow/analysis.py constructs panel_reference_values = [PANEL_BASELINE - value for value in panel_calls] (line 37) and feeds those complemented values into agreement_selector (line 39); the resulting selectors drive both the reported agreement_rate (line 42) and the emission_terms accumulation (lines 43-44). The report text nonetheless asserts comparison 'in the coding in which the reference panel is supplied' and displays staged_agreement_units = total_units - concordant_units (the supplied-coding count, 20) alongside the complement-coding rate 0.2000 and complement-coding emission 934, masking the substitution.
